end.summary:
Siya practised that health includes physical, mental, and social well-being, not only absence of illness.
They practised linking sleep, food, activity, screen use, and relationships to different parts of health; links were partly right and not steady yet.
They practised planning small routine changes such as breakfast, reduced gaming, outdoor play, sleep, breaks, and talking with others; effects were partly right and not steady yet.
The mix-up that only physical health counts was corrected later (child turns 11-13); this needs checking again next time.
end.parentNote: Siya practised connecting daily habits with physical, mental, and social health. Using examples about sleep, food, screen time, movement, and talking with others helped them later correct the mix-up that health is only about the body; the links and routine effects were partly right but not steady yet. At home, ask Siya to choose one small routine change and name its possible effect on all three parts of health.

Haan, aapne Arjun ke udaas aur akela hone ko health se joda; sirf fit dikhna kaafi nahi. Main ek aadat bolungi, aap bataiye woh body, mann ya rishton mein kahan madad karti hai: dost ke saath walk?
Neha ki health better hai, Arjun ka body theek hai par woh udaas aur akela rehta hai. Usko kisi se baat karni chahiye aur doston ke saath time bitana chahiye.
Haan, aapne Neha aur Arjun ka farq bataya. Mera sawaal dost ke saath walk par tha; shayad woh sunai nahi diya. Dost ke saath walk se body, mann ya rishton mein se kin kin ko madad mil sakti hai?

Neha ki all-round health behtar hai. Arjun ka body fit hai cricket se, par mann udaas aur akela... usko mental aur social health ke liye kisi se baat karni chahiye aur doston ke saath time bitana chahiye.
Haan, aap Arjun aur Neha ka farq samjha rahi hain. Main abhi dost ke saath walk ke baare mein pooch rahi thi; shayad meri baat clear nahi hui. Walk se body ko kya fayda ho sakta hai?

Neha ki all-round health better hai kyunki woh sirf body nahi, mann aur doston ke saath bhi theek hai. Arjun cricket se body fit hai par mann udaas aur akela... usko mental aur social health ke liye kisi se baat karni chahiye aur doston ke saath time bitana chahiye.

Haan, aapne Neha aur Arjun ke beech body, mann aur rishton ka farq bataya. Lagta hai mera walk wala sawaal sunai nahi de raha, isliye use chhodte hain. Ek naya sawaal: Rohan bimaar nahi hai, phir bhi poori tarah swasth kyon nahi ho sakta?

Haan... Rohan bimaar toh nahi hai, but health unka theek nahi. Woh sirf yeh nahi ki fever nahi. Jaise agar woh roz thoda sota hai, ya hamesha tension mein rehta hai, ya doston se baat nahi karta... toh body theek ho sakti hai but mann aur rishte kharab hain. Toh poora healthy nahi hai na.

Bilkul, aapne bataya ki fever na hona kaafi nahi; kam neend, tension aur doston se doori bhi health ko affect karte hain. Ab ek hafte roz sirf paanch ghante sone ka example lete hain. Exam mein padha hua zyada yaad rahega ya kam, aur kyon?
Kam yaad rahega... neend poori hai toh dimaag fresh nahi rahega, padha hua set nahi hoga. Jaise phone ki battery low, vaise.

Haan, aap keh rahi hain kam yaad rahega: paanch ghante ki neend se dimaag fresh nahi rahega. Battery low wali misaal bhi isi baat ko samjhati hai. Ab sochiye, kisi bharosemand insaan se pareshaani par baat karna health ki aadat kyon hai?
baat karne se stress kam hota hai na... mann halka feel karta hai, jaise burden share kar rahe hain. aur woh connection bhi banata hai, akele nahi lagte.

Bilkul, baat karne se stress kam ho sakta hai aur akelapan bhi; aapne mann aur rishton dono ko joda. Ab roz ke routine mein do chhote badlaav sochiye. Ek badlaav body ko aur doosra mann ya rishton ko kaise madad karega?

theek hai... ek badlaav toh breakfast lena, naashta. subah kuch khaane se body ko energy milegi aur class mein focus bhi hoga, mind bhi theek. doosra... mobile games 3 ghante is too much, uski jagah thoda dost ke saath baahar khel loon, physical hoga aur akele pan se bhi break. neend ke liye... raat 1 baje se pehle sona chahiye, kam se kam 10 baje, body aur dimaag dono fresh rahenge.

Haan, naashta se energy aur focus, games ki jagah doston ke saath khelne se body aur rishte, aur jaldi sone se neend ko fayda hoga. Aapne chhote badlaav aur unke asar dono jode. Ab ek mushkil situation: exams ke dauraan cousin bahut der padhte hain, khelna band kar dete hain aur kisi se baat nahi karte; body, mann aur rishton ke liye aap unhe kya chhoti salaah dengi?

dekho, itna padhai karna theek hai lekin poora din ek hi kaam... body ke liye breaks lena chahiye, jaise beech mein thoda walk ya stretch. neend bhi poori leni chahiye, kam se kam aath ghante, nahi toh dimaag kaam nahi karega. aur haan, ghar mein kisi se baat karte raho, jaise dinner ke time ya thoda break mein... akele akele stress badhta hai. bas, simple chhoti chhoti cheezein.

Aapne walk, neend aur ghar par baat karne ki practical salaah di. Isme body aur stress ka asar bhi joda. Ab ek nayi situation sochiye: Meena phone scroll karne ki jagah dost ke saath walk karti hai; ek mahine baad health ke kaunse hisse badal sakte hain, aur kyun?

umm... body health badlegi, walk se body fit hoti hai. par mann aur rishte... I guess they'll be same, unless she gets sick ya fever aaye. walk se body theek hai bass, health hai na doctor ke paas jaane ki zaroorat nahi.

Aap keh rahi hain walk se sirf body badlegi, mann aur rishte tabhi matter karenge jab fever ho. Sochiye, Meena walk par dost se apni tension share karti hai aur dono roz saath waqt bitate hain; bina fever ke bhi uske mann aur rishton mein kya badal sakta hai?
hmm... teeno badal sakte hain... walk se body fit, baat karne se mann halka, dost ke saath waqt se rishta strong... teeno theek ho sakte hain.

Haan, aapne teeno asar jode: walk se body, baat se mann, aur saath waqt se rishta. Ab ek contrast sochiye. Agar kisi ko bukhar nahi hai, lekin woh bahut stressed aur akela mehsoos karta hai, toh kya use poori tarah healthy kahenge, aur kyun?

nahi, bilkul nahi... sirf bukhar na hona health thodi hai na. stressed aur akela hai toh mann ki health kharab hai, aur doston se door hai toh social health bhi theek nahi. poori tarah healthy toh jab teeno theek honge.

Bilkul, bukhar na hona akela kaafi nahi; aapne stress ko mann se aur akelapan ko rishton se joda. Ab roz ki aadaton ko in teen hisson se jodte hain. Neend aur physical activity ke liye roz ka kya sujhaav hai?
